content: Anu…bani-yunggaj-gala nga ana-yimbaj, warra-wurru-wurruj warra-wajbarina waa-runggu-runggal warra-priest. Wunu-wajbarina-maynji naaynjaabu-nyung na-waḻyinyung, niga ni-yaarri na-God-guy wugurraa yadhu warra-wurru-wurruj. Niga nuuyii bayarra na-God-guy marri ni-nangana ana-mun-bulal-wulal-inyung, nguynju yadhu niga na-God ambanii-jarina alaaladi-yinyung warra-wurru-wurruj-gala.

Niga na-priest wunu-wajbarini-yinyung, niga ni-bilwilwiluj nigaaj-baj, niga ni-marrbuy warruburru-yung warra-wurru-wurruj warraaynjaaynjaabugij-gaj yagu anubani-yung niga ani-yambina andhurrg warruburru-wuy, waari-yinyung amburru-marrbuy-dhini ana-maaḻamburrg marri warruburru-yung waari-yinyung amburru-waṉbini ana-maaḻamburrg.
Yagu yamba anubani-yung, niga ni-nangana ana-mun-bulal-wulal-inyung nigawi-nyinyung-jinyung anaaladi marri warruburru-yung-jinyung warra-wurru-wurruj-jinyung anaaladi.

Nguynju-waj anubani-yung warraaynjaaynjaabugij-gaj niga yagi ni-wajbari nigaaj-baj yagu niga waari ni-runggal-wi nigaaj-baj, yagu na-God wanii-gaḏii warraaynjaaynjaabugij-gaj nguynju niga naa-gaḏangi na-Aaron anubani-yunggaj.
Anaani wiij-nguynju, na-Christ waari ani-runggal-wini nigaaj-baj yagu anubani-yung niga ni-runggal na-priest. Waari! Niga na-God na-Baba niga-waj ni-yamayn nigawi-wuy,
Ni-yamaa na-God, waarrarrina ana-wubiba-rruj. Marri anaaynbaj-duj, niga ni-yamayn,
Niga ni-yamayn anubani-yung-duj ana-wulawaa-rruj ana-lhaawu nubagi-yung-jinyung na-Jesus.

Anubani-yumbaa, na-Jesus ni-wiri-waj anaani ana-lhirribala, ni-yambini arrwiyaj na-God-guy marri nu-yandhawiwaa yanggarrwar marri ni-ruguni-windiyung. Niga naa-gaḏangi na-God-guy, nubagi-yung nu-wiri-gaa yungguyung. Ni-jambarrgiiyn marri nu-yandhurrbangaa na-God-guy. Wudani-yung-gala, nigaayung na-God nu-yaynjangani niga.
Niga na-God-jinyung na-Niwiyayung yagu niga ni-marrbuy-maa nu-yandhurrbangaa-yinyung na-God anubani-yung niga ni-warragayangi-maynji.
Nga niwu-jadugayn anubani ni-mijgalmini-yinyung. Warruburru-yung-maynji ambunu-yandhurrbangana niga, niga ambani-wiri-gang wugurru anggu-wuguuguni.
Nga aḏaba na-God nu-runggal-waa niga na-priest anggu-wuguuguni, wini-nguynju nubagi-yii na-Melchizedek-jii.
Ngagurru ngirri-waṉagana arrawindi ana-lhaawu anaani-yung-jinyung. Yagu anaani wu-miḏaamimi, nugurru yamba nurru-wurrugurrij nurru-marrbuy-mana-yinyung.

Aḏaba wij-maṉdhina nugurru-maynji narra-bajiyina-yinyung. Yagu waari. Yijgubulu, nugurru aadanu ngana-ngaynbandii ngana-bajiyina ngijang, anubani-yung ana-wulhu-wulhurr-inyung ana-runggal ana-lhaawu ana-wubiba-rruj na-God-jinyung-duj. Nugurru nurru-yamana nguynju warra-wirrig-jii, wirri-ngaynbandii mimi, waari ana-marrya warra-miyn-ngambara-yii.
Warruburru-yung warra-gujuju wugurru wurru-wuynjana ana-mimi. Nugurru aadanu nurru-yamana warra-gujuju-yii, waari numburru-marrbuy-mang ana-maaḻamburrg-jinyung.

Yagu ana-marrya warra-miyn-ngambara-yinyung, burru-yung-bugij wurru-nguyii. Wugurru wurru-marrbuy-mana maaḻamburrg-jinyung marri wurru-waṉbina ana-maaḻamburrg. Wudani-yung-gala, wugurru wurru-marrbuy anubani ana-mamanunggu yagu anaalaaladi.
